title: Cop tagged in Laos drug flight says she thought cargo was vapes, cigarettes
summary: The Philippine National Police Aviation Security Group cop who allegedly facilitated the plane involved in the aborted flight of illegal drugs from Laos to the Philippines told senators Wednesday…

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police Aviation Security Group cop who allegedly facilitated the plane involved in the aborted flight of illegal drugs from Laos to the Philippines told senators Wednesday that, as far as she knew, they were transporting vapes and cigarettes.
